tasks.context: A host asks a helper to bring a visitor's cup and keeps the suggested red cup for herself.
tasks.objective: Combine requested size and corrected color with a four-picture grid.
tasks.visualSupply: The four possible size/color combinations and their stable numbers.
tasks.heardSupply: Which size/color the visitor is to receive.
tasks.relationship: Shares descriptive vocabulary with the legacy shirt, umbrella and poster stories, not their event, participants, dialogue or questions. This is not the legacy dinner task-order story or pen-availability loan with replaced nouns.
tasks.accessibilityBoundary: Scored use requires distinguishing both size and blue/red; size alone cannot identify the answer. No color-independent scored equivalent is claimed. Described unscored study exposes all four labels equally.

tasks.context: An invitation is declined; the man retains Sunday and buys cinema tickets for himself and his younger brother.
tasks.objective: Listen for why two tickets are needed, not merely the date mentioned.
evidence: t5: brother accompanies him and he buys two tickets
tasks.heardSupply: The actual companion, rejected invitation and purchase.
tasks.relationship: Unlike n5-weekend-plans, the pair do not reschedule a shared outing; unlike n5-a-phone-message, there is no meeting-time response task; unlike the station/bus stories, this is not a route/fare task. No source story or audio is reused.

tasks.context: One of three friends aims a camera at the other two before taking their picture.
tasks.objective: Choose the marked photographer's direction, separating speaker role and before/after activity stage.
evidence: situation: about to take the picture
tasks.visualSupply: Which person holds and aims the camera, and which people are being photographed.
tasks.heardSupply: The activity is about to happen, followed by all three numbered candidate utterances.
tasks.relationship: Not the legacy picking-up-photos order/readiness transaction, and not A's borrowed-pencil fixture. The preliminary seat-permission idea was dropped to avoid approaching the existing restaurant episode.
tasks.accessibilityBoundary: The marked role is essential; explicit described unscored study is the contract-1 nonvisual alternative.

tasks.context: A person notices several bags and offers to carry one.
tasks.objective: Recognize an offer and choose the fitting acceptance rather than an action report or a grant of use.
tasks.heardSupply: The offer and all three numbered replies.
tasks.relationship: An independent help offer, not A's park invitation or a cut-down legacy transport/loan exchange. Shared polite formulas are language reuse, not a reused story.
tasks.pragmaticBoundary: An appropriate refusal would also fit an offer, so no refusal is labeled wrong.
